name: Minh Young Kim
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one static full-body transparent character candidate for Gear of wars combats.
Subject: Lieutenant Minh Young Kim specifically as he appears in Gears of War 3: RAAM's Shadow (2011). Input image is a scene capture from RAAM's Shadow: Kim is the bald armored man at the center-right, gesturing at the civilian. Recreate ONLY Kim, not the civilian or Barrick behind him.
Reference constraints: preserve Kim's distinctive clean-shaven bald East Asian face, thick dark eyebrows, square jaw, original rounded blue COG armor, two large circular black breast plates with fine metal rims, central dark COG insignia, scuffed cyan-blue borders and rounded pauldrons, brown shoulder straps and buckles, dark full sleeves and armored gloves. Keep the double belt structure and circular lower belt buckle with small metal panels shown in the capture. Do not substitute a Gears 5/Ultimate Edition remastered face or altered armor, and no helmet. The source does not show lower legs; continue his standard dark original-era COG field trousers, restrained knee/shin armor and broad combat boots in matching materials, without adding new emblems or unusual futuristic shapes.
Composition: exactly ONE subject, neutral standing full body seen in front three-quarter view facing screen RIGHT; face/nose and both boot toes point clearly right. Empty hands, relaxed at sides, no gesture and no weapon, no combat action. Whole head, hands and complete soles must fit comfortably. Subject occupies 75% of total canvas height only; at least 10% genuine transparent space at all four sides, especially above the head and beneath both feet.
Style: detailed realistic Gears game-character render, heavy grounded proportions and worn blue steel, dark fabric, neutral readable illumination, no stylization into a toy.
Backdrop: actual transparent alpha PNG. No scene, no floor or ground shadow, no background gradient, no halo, no text, no HUD, no additional character, no animation or multiple poses.

sources.scope: Média public RS_Kim.jpg téléchargé et inspecté : Kim au premier plan d'une scène RAAM's Shadow, avec Barrick derrière. Visage, torse et ceinture visibles, jambes non visibles. Page Fandom non lisible robots.
Communiqué Microsoft/Epic 2011 confirmant la présence de Kim dans RAAM's Shadow. Illustration du communiqué est RAAM, exclue de la génération.

source_research.scope: Recherche primaire complémentaire ciblée avant un seul nouvel essai autorisé, non exhaustive.
limitations: Capture exacte de RAAM’s Shadow réhébergée ; visage, torse et ceintures visibles, jambes hors champ.
Le communiqué Microsoft/Epic réédité par l’AFJV confirme Kim dans le DLC, sans vue finale complète supplémentaire.
Les figurines Kim du premier Gears et les versions remasterisées ne sont pas substituées au DLC.
